name: motion-graphics
description: Motion graphics by technique, not by style, rendered with HyperFrames (HTML + CSS + GSAP to video, pinned 0.9.34, no telemetry): a master skill (keyword MOTION GRAPHICS) plus eight combinable technique skills, a ready-to-render kit (60 fps, no GPU, 13 mixable directions), AI-generated elements (objects, backgrounds, textures, characters, products, seamless loops) integrated with cut-out, alpha, color and sync, and a frozen Remotion kit for the pieces not yet ported.
